title: Subjunctive Mood & Formal Demands: It is Vital That He Be Informed
objective: Menguasai penggunaan subjunctive mood dalam resolusi resmi, rekomendasi mendesak, dan protokol hukum.

theory.summary: Subjunctive mood adalah bentuk khusus dalam bahasa Inggris formal yang digunakan untuk menyatakan tuntutan, rekomendasi, atau keharusan. Berbeda dengan bentuk biasa, subjunctive menggunakan bare infinitive (bentuk dasar kata kerja tanpa -s/-es) setelah kata kerja atau ungkapan tertentu, bahkan untuk subjek orang ketiga tunggal. Struktur ini sangat penting dalam dokumen hukum, resolusi perusahaan, rekomendasi formal, dan komunikasi profesional tingkat tinggi.
rules: Formula dasar: Subject + demand/insist/recommend/suggest/require + that + subject + BARE INFINITIVE (be, go, do, submit). Contoh: The board insists that he BE present (bukan 'is' atau 'be present').
Dengan ekspresi formal: It is vital/essential/imperative/crucial + that + subject + BARE INFINITIVE. Contoh: It is essential that every member SUBMIT their report by Friday.

Bentuk negatif menggunakan 'not' sebelum bare infinitive: The lawyer recommended that the witness NOT answer that question. Untuk ekspresi formal: It is important that she NOT be disturbed during the meeting.

commonTrap.explanation: Banyak siswa level B2 secara otomatis menambahkan -s untuk orang ketiga tunggal atau menggunakan 'is/are' karena terbiasa dengan grammar biasa. Dalam subjunctive mood, SELALU gunakan bare infinitive tanpa perubahan apapun, tidak peduli subjeknya.
commonTrap.wrong: The committee demands that he submits his resignation immediately. / It is vital that she is informed of the changes.
commonTrap.correct: The committee demands that he SUBMIT his resignation immediately. / It is vital that she BE informed of the changes.

Lengkapi dialog percakapan berikut sesuai konteks:
General Counsel: "We need to finalize the board resolution for the merger. It's imperative that every director be notified at least 48 hours in advance."
Corporate Secretary: "[...]"
options: Sorry, I forgot my keys at home.
Understood. The regulations also stipulate that the resolution be filed with the regulatory authority within five business days.
The committee demands that he submits his resignation immediately

Peraturan juga menetapkan bahwa resolusi harus diajukan ke otoritas pengawas dalam lima hari kerja.") adalah jawaban yang tepat dan alami sesuai alur percakapan tokoh Corporate Secretary.

vocab.collocation: The CEO insists that all managers attend the quarterly review meeting.
It is imperative that the security protocols be updated before the system goes live.
The new regulation mandates that every organization report their carbon emissions annually.
The contract stipulates that payment be made within thirty days of invoice date.
Full compliance with data protection regulations requires that all user information be encrypted.
The board passed a resolution requiring that the CFO present financial reports monthly.
The audit committee's recommendation is that the company adopt stricter internal controls.
Safety protocols demand that all visitors be accompanied by authorized personnel at all times.
The policy designates that a senior officer be present during all disciplinary hearings.
We urgently request that you expedite the approval process for this critical application.

dialogue.context: Diskusi formal antara General Counsel (penasihat hukum umum) dan Corporate Secretary mengenai resolusi dewan direksi untuk merger perusahaan.

lines.speaker: General Counsel
lines.text: We need to finalize the board resolution for the merger. It's imperative that every director be notified at least 48 hours in advance.
lines.translation: Kita perlu menyelesaikan resolusi dewan untuk merger. Sangat penting bahwa setiap direktur diberitahu setidaknya 48 jam sebelumnya.

lines.speaker: Corporate Secretary
lines.text: Understood. The regulations also stipulate that the resolution be filed with the regulatory authority within five business days.
lines.translation: Dimengerti. Peraturan juga menetapkan bahwa resolusi harus diajukan ke otoritas pengawas dalam lima hari kerja.

lines.speaker: General Counsel
lines.text: Exactly. I recommend that we also insist the auditors submit their due diligence report before the vote takes place.
lines.translation: Tepat sekali. Saya merekomendasikan kita juga menuntut auditor menyerahkan laporan uji tuntas mereka sebelum pemungutan suara berlangsung.

lines.speaker: Corporate Secretary
lines.text: Good point. Should we mandate that all shareholders be given access to the merger documents two weeks prior?
lines.translation: Poin yang bagus. Haruskah kita mewajibkan semua pemegang saham diberi akses ke dokumen merger dua minggu sebelumnya?

lines.speaker: General Counsel
lines.text: Absolutely. It's vital that full transparency be maintained throughout this process. Any legal challenges could delay everything.
lines.translation: Tentu saja. Sangat penting bahwa transparansi penuh dijaga sepanjang proses ini. Tantangan hukum apapun bisa menunda semuanya.

lines.speaker: Corporate Secretary
lines.text: I'll draft the resolution language accordingly. One more thing—do we require that the CFO be present at the shareholder meeting?
lines.translation: Saya akan menyusun bahasa resolusinya sesuai dengan itu. Satu hal lagi—apakah kita mewajibkan CFO hadir di rapat pemegang saham?

lines.speaker: General Counsel
lines.text: Yes, protocol demands that both the CEO and CFO attend to answer any financial questions. Let's ensure the notice reflects that.
lines.translation: Ya, protokol menuntut bahwa CEO dan CFO hadir untuk menjawab pertanyaan keuangan apapun. Mari kita pastikan pemberitahuan mencerminkan hal itu.

lines.speaker: Corporate Secretary
lines.text: Perfect. I'll have the draft on your desk by end of day. We need to move quickly on this.
lines.translation: Sempurna. Saya akan memberikan draf ke meja Anda pada akhir hari. Kita perlu bergerak cepat dalam hal ini.

speakingLab.context: Anda adalah seorang Legal Compliance Officer yang sedang berlatih menyusun rekomendasi formal dengan Mr. Khoirul. Gunakan subjunctive mood dengan tepat dalam skenario profesional ini.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Today we're practicing formal recommendations using the subjunctive mood. Imagine you're writing a compliance memo. How would you recommend that all employees complete cybersecurity training?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I recommend that all employees complete the mandatory cybersecurity training by the end of this quarter.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent use of the subjunctive! Now, make it more urgent using 'It is imperative that...' and include a deadline.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: It is imperative that every employee complete the cybersecurity training before March 31st to ensure full compliance with our security protocols.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Perfect! Now let's try a negative form. How would you insist that contractors NOT access confidential files without authorization?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: The company insists that contractors not access any confidential files without prior written authorization from the department head.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Outstanding! Notice you used 'not access' rather than 'do not access'—that's the correct subjunctive form. For your final task, create a formal demand using 'stipulate' about document retention.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: The regulation stipulates that all financial records be retained for a minimum of seven years and that they be stored in secure, auditable formats.

quiz.question: The board of directors demands that the CEO ___ at the emergency meeting tomorrow.
quiz.explanation: Setelah 'demands that', kita harus menggunakan bare infinitive (attend), bukan bentuk present tense biasa (attends). Subjunctive mood tidak mengikuti aturan orang ketiga tunggal yang biasa menambahkan -s.

quiz.question: It is essential that every document ___ reviewed by the legal team before publication.
quiz.explanation: Dengan ekspresi 'It is essential that', kita menggunakan bare infinitive 'be', bukan 'is' atau 'will be'. Ini adalah aturan subjunctive mood dalam bahasa Inggris formal yang wajib digunakan dalam konteks tuntutan dan rekomendasi.

quiz.question: The contract stipulates that payment ___ made within 30 days of invoice receipt.
quiz.explanation: Kata kerja 'stipulate' memicu subjunctive mood, sehingga kita menggunakan 'be' (bare infinitive), bukan 'is' atau 'must be'. Struktur subjunctive sudah mengandung makna keharusan, jadi 'must' tidak diperlukan.

quiz.question: The safety protocol requires that all visitors ___ protective equipment in the laboratory area.
quiz.explanation: Setelah 'requires that', kita menggunakan bare infinitive 'wear' untuk semua subjek, termasuk orang ketiga tunggal. Ini berbeda dari kalimat biasa dimana 'visitors' akan menggunakan 'wear' dalam present simple, tapi di sini konteksnya adalah subjunctive formal.

quiz.question: The committee recommends that the policy ___ implemented until further review is completed.
quiz.explanation: Bentuk negatif dalam subjunctive mood adalah 'not + bare infinitive', jadi 'not be' adalah yang benar. 'Is not' menggunakan present tense biasa, dan 'not to be' adalah bentuk infinitive yang salah dalam konteks ini. Ingat: subjunctive negatif = not + bare infinitive.
